movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Holding and manipulating woven bamboo or rattan hobbyhorses decorated with beads and sequins.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Staged within a cordoned-off area separated from spectators; performers move in formations representing horse-mounted troops.
movement_profile.partnering: Group ensemble dancing depicting a troop of two to eight horsemen.

signature_moves.description: Dancers straddle flat woven bamboo or rattan mounts decorated with paint, sequins, and cloth to portray cavalry.
signature_moves.name: Hobbyhorse riding

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid confusing East Javanese Jathilan with trance variants: Jathil dancers do not perform glass eating, coal walking, or spirit possession.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Percussive accompaniment provided by dog-dog drums, gongs, and angklung.
music_profile.sound_description: A driving percussive acoustic texture driven by interlocking angklung, deep gongs, and the rhythmic beat of dog-dog drums, punctuated by the metallic jingle of small bells strung around the dancers' ankles.
music_profile.vocal_style: Audience chorus singing in related Balinese variants; vocal style for Jathilan not described in sources.

teaching.formation: Group of two to eight dancers in a cordoned-off performance area separated from the audience.
teaching.level_notes: Performers mount flat woven bamboo horses and execute synchronized troop riding movements while wearing ankle bells.
